summary: project_knowledge_gates is a pure typed projection; inputs: catalog_stale, read_set_same, source_bytes_same booleans; stale catalog + unchanged read set + unchanged source bytes => degraded-continuation, publication disallowed, review not required; unchanged read set + changed source bytes => successor-refresh, publication disallowed, review not required; all other combinations => repair-required, publication disallowed, review required; no ambiguities
